protocol_commits.subject: Pre-specified protocol for the definition-harmonization analysis of the z~0 stellar mass functions
Protocol amendment A1: mass-scatter operator with a validation gate, added before any E1-E4 statistic was computed

Protocol amendment A2 and its implementation: galaxy-level aperture remap with Jacobian replaces level-matched shifts; synthetic tests (committed before E1, E2, E4 or any sensitivity statistic was computed)

result_first_commit.subject: v0.21.0: confirmatory run of the pre-specified harmonization analysis (not detected), generated report, site Findings section, verification chain

protocol_commits.subject: Pre-registered protocol for the parametric-versus-structural analysis of the cosmic star formation history, with its analysis code and synthetic tests (committed before any real spread, variant deviation, emulator fit, reachability distance or posterior was computed)
